native_monetization.note: 10 for native paid checkout/licensing; 5 for selective monetization; 0 for external-only or free distribution; unknown when unverified.

sources.method: Manual research and source availability review; see per-metric evidence classification

research_tasks: Verify Slovak publisher onboarding and payout country support
Find 5–10 products first released within 24 months; record launch source separately from latest update
Record current traction and actual payment evidence; do not infer revenue from price or downloads
Sample 10 direct alternatives in one niche, including free options and review concentration
Run a host integration and packaging spike; record manual testing and review effort

deep_dive.status: Initial evidence review; commercial validation incomplete
